title: 电商通用关键词
html:
电商通用关键词

概述

本章覆盖电商业务各环节的通用英语词汇，分为商品与库存、订单与支付、营销与转化、物流与配送四个部分。它解决的是在电商场景中读懂业务术语、用英语描述交易流程的问题。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适用于日常沟通与业务文档。建议按业务链条的顺序学习，从商品到订单再到营销和物流，形成对交易全流程的整体认识。

商品与库存

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
product n. 产品 product listing, product catalog
SKU n. 库存单位 SKU management, unique SKU
inventory n. 库存 inventory management, check inventory
stock n. 存货 in stock, out of stock
variant n. 变体 color variant, size variant
catalog n. 目录 product catalog, browse the catalog

听说例句

A: How many SKUs do we have in the catalog? B: About 15,000 active SKUs. We need to update the inventory for the new color variants.

A: Is this item still in stock? B: Let me check. The system shows 50 units available, but the warehouse hasn't confirmed.

写作表达

  • The product catalog has been expanded to include over 20,000 SKUs across 15 categories.
  • Efficient inventory management ensures that stock levels are maintained to meet customer demand.

订单与支付

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
order n. 订单 place an order, order status
checkout n. 结账 checkout process, proceed to checkout
transaction n. 交易 complete a transaction, transaction history
refund n./v. 退款 issue a refund, refund policy
payment n. 付款 payment method, process payment
invoice n. 发票 generate an invoice, invoice number

听说例句

A: The customer wants a refund for order #12345. B: Let me check the transaction history. If it meets the refund policy, I'll process it right away.

A: Are we seeing any drop-off at checkout? B: Yes, about 30% abandon at the payment step. We should add more payment methods.

写作表达

  • The checkout process has been optimized to reduce cart abandonment by 25%.
  • All transactions are encrypted and comply with PCI DSS standards for payment security.

营销与转化

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
conversion n. 转化 conversion rate, conversion funnel
campaign n. 活动 marketing campaign, launch a campaign
promotion n. 促销 run a promotion, promotional offer
coupon n. 优惠券 apply a coupon, coupon code
discount n. 折扣 discount rate, offer a discount
retention n. 留存 customer retention, retention rate

听说例句

A: How did the Black Friday campaign perform? B: The conversion rate was 8.5%, up 2% from last year. Coupon usage also increased significantly.

A: Should we offer a discount to improve retention? B: I suggest a loyalty promotion instead — discounts attract one-time buyers, but promotions build habits.

写作表达

  • The marketing campaign resulted in a 35% increase in conversion rate and a 20% lift in average order value.
  • Customer retention strategies, including personalized promotions, contributed to a 15% reduction in churn.

物流与配送

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
shipping n. 运输 free shipping, shipping fee
logistics n. 物流 logistics partner, logistics chain
fulfillment n. 履约 order fulfillment, fulfillment center
tracking n. 追踪 tracking number, shipment tracking
warehouse n. 仓库 warehouse management, local warehouse
delivery n. 配送 same-day delivery, delivery time

听说例句

A: When will the shipment arrive? B: The tracking shows it left the fulfillment center yesterday. Expected delivery is in two days.

A: Should we partner with a new logistics provider? B: Our current partner handles warehouse operations well, but delivery times in rural areas need improvement.

写作表达

  • The fulfillment center processes an average of 50,000 orders per day with a 99.5% accuracy rate.
  • Offering free shipping on orders above $50 has proven to significantly increase average order value.
